articles.title: Crypto enjoys bullish bounce post-Fed rate hike: Crypto Week Ahead
articles.description: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Sept. 21.

articles.title: Hana Bank issues South Korea’s first digital bond using Euroclear’s blockchain
articles.description: South Korea's second-largest bank’s $100 million foreign-currency bond blockchain issuance shortened settlement time to the same day from three to five business days.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin hits $85,000 as short liquidations hit $300 million in an hour
articles.description: Crypto majors climbed alongside equity futures on Monday, with Monero's XMR up 13%, as Brent fell for a fourth straight session and traders positioned ahead of a Trump-Xi summit later this week.

articles.title: Kalshi faces ‘fake crypto volume’ allegations as critic flags identical $5,500 trades
articles.description: A trader alleged on X that Kalshi is inflating trading volumes in its ether perpetual futures.

articles.title: Bitcoin rises above $81,000, while NEAR jumps 23% on Zcash swap traffic
articles.description: Bitcoin extended a slow climb through the Asian session while regional equities and U.S. stock futures rose on progress in trade talks between Washington and Beijing.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s price has cleared a key hurdle that has historically preceded major bull runs
articles.description: Bitcoin's price has topped its 50-week average for the first time in 45 weeks, a major bullish signal.

articles.title: Crypto platform Gemini’s stock is down 80% from its IPO. That’s reviving takeover speculation
articles.description: The crypto platform’s market value has fallen to about $753 million, putting fresh attention on the licenses, custody infrastructure and customer relationships a buyer could inherit.

articles.title: Coinbase, Robinhood, Circle could be early winners of SEC's tokenized-stock push, analysts say
articles.description: Goldman Sachs and Citizens analysts said the agency's move create new opportunities in custody, tokenization infrastructure and stablecoin settlement, while giving brokers room to expand onchain products.

articles.title: Crypto traders braced for a total wipeout this week but Bitcoin had other plans
articles.description: Market experts view bitcoin’s price stability as evidence of its fundamental independence from Washington, maintaining that global liquidity and adoption cycles remain the primary growth drivers.

articles.title: Clarity Act, we hardly knew ye: We look at what was in the bill and what's replacing it
articles.description: U.S. agencies are racing to substitute their regulations for the law that was meant to set crypto markets in governmental bedrock, but will the stand-ins last?

articles.title: 'We have lost control': Crypto pioneer warns AI could trigger systemic banking and infrastructure shocks
articles.description: Marc van der Chijs sold much of his bitcoin to invest in AI. Now, growing concerns about the technology accompany a move to put some profits back into crypto.

articles.title: Ripple says asset managers are preparing for XRP Ledger’s next payments upgrade
articles.description: The upcoming Batch V1.1 can make linked asset and payment transfers succeed together or fail together, and Ripple says commercial projects are already being built around the feature after an extensive security review.

articles.title: 'The orange tie stays': Michael Saylor responds to venture capitalist's bitcoin obituary
articles.description: "Bitcoin feels like the CD in the age of Spotify, the DVD in the age of Netflix," wrote Jason Calacanis.

articles.title: Robinhood Chain fees collapse 97% even as transactions stay near record highs
articles.description: Seven-day average fees fell 82% while transaction counts slipped 6%, with about $1.5 billion a day still changing hands.

articles.title: Why Wall Street giants build tokenization money for institutions, not regular consumers
articles.description: JPMorgan and Citi move billions in tokenized deposits, but only among their branches. A U.K. challenger bank is about to do something neither has done.

articles.title: CFTC sends crypto rules to White House to review as Congress stalls on Clarity Act
articles.description: The regulator is moving ahead with crypto market rules as the SEC also opens a new path for tokenized stock trading.

articles.title: Crypto tech provider Haruko hit by cyberattack affecting 15 clients, some funds lost
articles.description: Some smaller hedge funds with weaker security controls may have lost funds in the targeted attack, sources said.

articles.title: DHS’s predictive policing is unconstitutional, un-American and should be stopped
articles.description: Targeting Americans based on what their spending habits can tell us about their politics is an abuse of our financial system, writes Coin Center’s Laz Pieper.

articles.title: ECB President Christine Lagarde intervened to block Binance’s EU MiCA license: WSJ
articles.description: Although the ECB holds no formal licensing authority under MiCA, high-level intervention led Greece to stall an application that regulators had previously deemed complete, the Journal said.

articles.title: Zcash targets November upgrade to make private payments up to three times faster
articles.description: NU7 would reduce block times to 25 seconds while setting aside at least 60% of transaction fees to supplement mining rewards beginning in 2031.

articles.title: XRP on the brink of a golden cross as focus switches to altcoins
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 18, 2026

articles.title: Layer-2 and DeFi tokens lead broad crypto advance as post-Fed hike nerves fade
articles.description: Starknet and arbitrum gained more than 17% while the 10-year Treasury yield slipped back below 5%, with 98 of CoinDesk 100 constituents advancing.

articles.title: Bitcoin weathers September storm as rate hikes and Clarity act setback test bulls
articles.description: Bitcoin is down just 1.5% in its historically weakest month and remains on track for its first quarterly gain in a year, despite rising rates, surging oil and a stronger dollar.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs over $80,000 as crypto shakes off Clarity failure and higher interest rates
articles.description: Another central bank hiked rates overnight, this time the Bank of Japan. The move failed to halt the slide in the yen.

articles.title: SBI Group backs payments firm dtcpay in $25 million funding round
articles.description: Stablecoin payments company dtcpay completed a $25 million Series A funding round with a strategic investment from Japan’s SBI Group.
